result.title: Manga2Animate: An Agentic Framework for Faithful Manga Animation with Script and Storyboard Planning
result.summary: Adapting existing manga into coherent animation that stays faithful to the source is a valuable yet challenging task. Existing methods either access the manga mainly through text, losing its characters and art style, or feed manga pages directly into video generation models, which misinterpret the manga's structure and produce incorrect storylines. In this paper, we propose Manga2Animate, a multi-agent framework that grounds every stage of generation in the source manga. We decompose the task into two intermediate representations, an animation script and a visual storyboard. Each representation is produced by a creator agent and reviewed against the source panels by a paired reviewer agent. We tailor representation-specific selection and dual-level feedback to progressively refine both before synthesizing the final animation. Extensive experiments and a user study demonstrate that Manga2Animate produces animations more faithful to the source manga and more consistent across shots than state-of-the-art approaches. Project page: https://annchenn.github.io/Manga2Animate/

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Manga2Animate 多智能体框架，通过生成动画脚本与视觉分镜这两种中间表示，并由配对审阅智能体对照原漫画进行反馈与筛选，最终合成更忠实于原作的动画。
